title: FBI Photo B007
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or optical tracking display. At the center is a crosshair reticle with graduated tick marks forming a cross, labeled with numbers 15, 10, 5 on both the left and right sides of the horizontal axis. In the upper right-center area is a small dark shape resembling a helicopter viewed from above or at an angle. The frame contains multiple black and gray horizontal rectangular bars resembling redaction blocks arranged symmetrically on the left and right edges and across the top. A small dark dot appears in the lower center-right area. A date-time stamp reads in the lower left corner. The overall image has visible noise/grain typical of low-light imaging.

observations.claim: A crosshair reticle with tick marks is centered in the image
Numeric labels 15, 10, 5 appear along the horizontal axis on both sides
A dark helicopter-like shape appears in the upper right-center
A timestamp reading '12/31/99 18:10:02' is in the lower left corner
Several black rectangular bars resembling redactions are present at the top and edges
The image is grayscale with visible grain/noise
A small dark dot is present in the lower center-right region

pages.reticle_style: large full-frame crosshair with white tick marks

tracked_object.notes: same speck position as B006 — sensor stabilized on this object

other_frame_features.helicopter_position: approximately (+5, +5); moved RIGHT and DOWN relative to B006 by ~4.5 tick units in 2 seconds; rotor/body silhouette clearer than in B006
